controls.title: Establish AI accountability ownership
controls.description: Assign clear accountability for AI outcomes.
controls.detailed_description: Formally assign accountability for AI system outcomes, including approval, monitoring, incident escalation, remediation, and risk acceptance. Document accountable roles (e.g., RACI/governance charter) and ensure responsibilities apply to both automated and AI-influenced decisions. Review role coverage when the system, data, or deployment context changes.
faira_part_c_reference: Part C – Accountability and governance controls

controls.title: Define human-in-the-loop decision points
controls.description: Define where human oversight is required for AI-influenced decisions.
controls.detailed_description: Identify decision points where AI outputs could materially affect individuals, service access, safety, legal rights, or compliance. Specify when human review/approval is mandatory, when overrides are permitted, and what escalation pathways apply. Document thresholds, roles, and evidence required for sign-off, and test the workflow in operational scenarios.
faira_part_c_reference: Part C – Accountability and governance controls
Part C – Reliability and safety controls

controls.title: Define accountability for third-party AI
controls.description: Clarify accountability boundaries for vendor or partner AI components.
controls.detailed_description: For externally sourced AI or components, define accountability boundaries and ensure the organisation retains accountable ownership for outcomes. Include contractual requirements for risk management, incident notification, change management, assurance evidence, and audit/inspection rights. Establish processes to manage vendor updates and dependencies that affect risk.
faira_part_c_reference: Part C – Accountability and governance controls
Part C – Procurement and third‑party risk considerations

controls.title: Monitor accountability effectiveness
controls.description: Periodically review whether accountability arrangements are effective in practice.
controls.detailed_description: Conduct periodic reviews of accountability arrangements to confirm responsibilities remain clear, exercised, and sufficient. Include checks of decision logs, escalations, incidents, staff understanding, and governance meeting outcomes. Record actions and track completion, especially following incidents or material changes.
faira_part_c_reference: Part C – Accountability and governance controls
Part C – Monitoring and assurance

controls.title: Conduct reliability testing
controls.description: Test AI behaviour for reliability under realistic operating conditions.
controls.detailed_description: Test the AI system against documented acceptance criteria, including performance consistency, error handling, edge cases, and failure modes. Validate behaviour across representative data and operational conditions, and repeat testing after material changes (model, data, prompts, integrations, environment). Store test results and sign-off decisions.
faira_part_c_reference: Part C – Reliability and safety controls

controls.title: Implement safe disengagement mechanisms
controls.description: Provide safe pause/override/shutdown mechanisms for AI functionality.
controls.detailed_description: Implement controls to safely disable, pause, or override AI outputs/actions (e.g., kill switch, rollback, fallback mode). Define who can trigger disengagement, under what conditions, and how service continuity is maintained. Test disengagement procedures periodically and after changes.
faira_part_c_reference: Part C – Reliability and safety controls

controls.title: Establish AI-specific incident response
controls.description: Integrate AI-specific failures into incident response and escalation.
controls.detailed_description: Extend incident response to cover AI-specific failure modes (harmful outputs, model drift, prompt injection, data leakage, bias incidents). Define detection signals, severity triage, escalation paths, comms templates, containment steps, and post-incident review requirements. Maintain a log of AI incidents and lessons learned.
faira_part_c_reference: Part C – Reliability and safety controls
Part C – Monitoring and assurance

controls.title: Monitor ongoing system performance
controls.description: Continuously monitor AI performance, drift, and unintended behaviour.
controls.detailed_description: Define performance and safety KPIs (accuracy, error rates, drift indicators, hallucination rate, override frequency) and implement monitoring with alert thresholds. Review monitoring outputs regularly and trigger retraining, prompt changes, or rollback where thresholds are exceeded. Record reviews and actions taken.
faira_part_c_reference: Part C – Monitoring and assurance
Part C – Reliability and safety controls

controls.title: Apply data minimisation and access controls
controls.description: Limit data to what is necessary and restrict access by role and need.
controls.detailed_description: Map data flows and ensure only necessary data is collected, used, and retained. Implement role-based access control to training data, inputs, outputs, and logs. Enforce least privilege, separation of duties, and secure storage. Apply retention and disposal rules aligned to records and privacy obligations.
faira_part_c_reference: Part C – Privacy and data protection controls

controls.title: Implement privacy risk mitigations
controls.description: Implement and track mitigations identified through privacy/data assessments.
controls.detailed_description: Where privacy risks are identified (e.g., PIA, data risk assessment), implement mitigations such as anonymisation, pseudonymisation, redaction, consent/notice controls, access restrictions, and breach response readiness. Track mitigations to closure with owners and due dates, and re-assess after material changes.
faira_part_c_reference: Part C – Privacy and data protection controls
Part C – Monitoring and assurance

controls.title: Control sensitive output disclosure
controls.description: Prevent outputs from exposing sensitive or regulated information.
controls.detailed_description: Implement output controls to prevent leakage of sensitive or regulated data (e.g., redaction, suppression, classification-based filters, prompt guardrails). Validate controls using test cases and ensure exceptions are logged and reviewed. Where applicable, apply least disclosure principles and safe response patterns.
faira_part_c_reference: Part C – Privacy and data protection controls
Part C – Transparency and explainability considerations

controls.title: Secure AI infrastructure and integrations
controls.description: Apply security controls across AI infrastructure and connected systems.
controls.detailed_description: Secure AI infrastructure, APIs, and integrations using standard security practices (authentication, encryption, network controls, vulnerability management, logging). Validate supply chain components, manage secrets, and harden integration points. Ensure security testing includes AI-specific threats (prompt injection, poisoning, model extraction) where relevant.
faira_part_c_reference: Part C – Privacy and data protection controls
Part C – Reliability and safety controls

controls.title: Test and monitor for bias
controls.description: Identify, mitigate, and monitor bias risks in AI outputs and decisions.
controls.detailed_description: Assess training data and system outputs for bias that could produce unfair impacts on individuals or groups. Define fairness metrics appropriate to the context, test for disparate impact, implement mitigations (data balancing, constraints, human review), and monitor fairness outcomes over time with periodic re-testing.
faira_part_c_reference: Part C – Fairness controls

controls.title: Review decision impacts on affected groups
controls.description: Assess and address disproportionate impacts on affected groups.
controls.detailed_description: Identify groups potentially affected by AI outcomes and assess whether impacts are disproportionate or unfair. Incorporate feedback and lived experience where appropriate, and implement corrective actions such as policy constraints, targeted monitoring, and additional safeguards for vulnerable groups.
faira_part_c_reference: Part C – Fairness controls
Part C – Engagement and affected persons

controls.title: Safeguard human autonomy and dignity
controls.description: Ensure AI supports human agency and avoids inappropriate reliance.
controls.detailed_description: Define appropriate use boundaries and ensure humans retain meaningful agency where judgement is required. Implement safeguards against automation bias and over-reliance (e.g., mandatory review, decision aids, training). Ensure AI outputs are framed as support, not authority, unless explicitly approved for automation with suitable safeguards.
faira_part_c_reference: Part C – Human-centred values controls
Part C – Accountability and governance controls

controls.title: Manage workforce impacts
controls.description: Mitigate negative impacts on staff roles, workload, and wellbeing.
controls.detailed_description: Assess workforce impacts (workload, job redesign, skills, stress) and implement mitigations such as training, role redesign, communications, and support arrangements. Engage affected staff early, define new responsibilities, and monitor wellbeing impacts after deployment.
faira_part_c_reference: Part C – Human-centred values controls
Part C – Wellbeing and broader impacts

controls.title: Inform people about AI use
controls.description: Provide clear disclosure when AI is used and why.
controls.detailed_description: Implement proportionate notices to inform users and affected parties when AI is used, its purpose, and key limitations. Ensure disclosures are accessible, understandable, and appropriate to the channel (UI notices, scripts, policies). Maintain versioned disclosure content and review when system behaviour changes.
faira_part_c_reference: Part C – Transparency and explainability controls
Part C – Engagement and affected persons

controls.title: Provide explainability mechanisms
controls.description: Provide meaningful explanations appropriate to the decision context.
controls.detailed_description: Provide explanations for outputs/decisions proportionate to impact (what inputs mattered, high-level reasoning, confidence/limits, and how to seek review). Tailor explanations to audiences (staff, citizens, oversight bodies) and document limitations where full explainability is not feasible.
faira_part_c_reference: Part C – Transparency and explainability controls

controls.title: Enable challenge and review of AI outcomes
controls.description: Provide a clear contestability process with timely review and correction.
controls.detailed_description: Establish accessible channels for affected parties to challenge AI outcomes. Define SLAs for response and review, ensure human review is available where appropriate, document how decisions are reconsidered, and record outcomes and corrective actions. Ensure staff understand the process and that systemic issues are escalated to governance.
faira_part_c_reference: Part C – Contestability controls
Part C – Transparency and explainability controls

controls.title: Monitor societal and environmental impacts
controls.description: Consider and review broader societal and environmental impacts over time.
controls.detailed_description: Identify potential broader impacts (community trust, exclusion, service equity, environmental footprint) and define monitoring/review cadence proportionate to scale and sensitivity. Record findings, engage stakeholders where appropriate, and implement mitigations where broader harms are identified.
faira_part_c_reference: Part C – Wellbeing and broader impacts
Part C – Monitoring and assurance

controls.title: Manage AI lifecycle changes
controls.description: Assess and manage risk implications arising from changes to AI systems.
controls.detailed_description: Establish a process to identify and assess material changes to AI systems, including changes to models, data sources, prompts, integrations, deployment context, or intended use. Require risk review and appropriate approval prior to deployment of changes, and confirm that existing controls remain effective following change implementation.
faira_part_c_reference: Part C – Accountability and governance controls
Part C – Reliability and safety controls

controls.title: Review AI decision outcomes
controls.description: Periodically review AI-influenced decisions to confirm outcomes remain appropriate.
controls.detailed_description: Conduct periodic reviews of AI-influenced decisions to assess whether outcomes remain appropriate, consistent, and aligned with intended use. Reviews may include sampling decisions, examining overrides, assessing error patterns, and identifying emerging issues. Record findings and track follow-up actions where concerns are identified.
faira_part_c_reference: Part C – Monitoring and assurance
Part C – Accountability and governance controls
Part C – Fairness controls

controls.title: Monitor contestability effectiveness
controls.description: Review whether contestability processes operate effectively in practice.
controls.detailed_description: Periodically review contestability processes to confirm they are accessible, timely, and result in meaningful review or correction where appropriate. Assess challenge volumes, response times, outcomes, and user feedback, and escalate systemic issues through governance arrangements.
faira_part_c_reference: Part C – Contestability controls
Part C – Monitoring and assurance

recommendation_rules.name: High residual domain risk => all domain controls

then.rationale_template: Residual risk is {domain_residual_risk_level} in {domain}; implement targeted controls to reduce remaining exposure.

recommendation_rules.name: Overall residual risk high => core assurance controls

then.rationale_template: Overall residual risk is {overall_residual_risk_level}; strengthen governance, transparency, incident response, and contestability.
Deployment is {A5.11}; ensure clear disclosure, meaningful explanations, and contestability for affected parties.

recommendation_rules.name: Autonomous action enabled => HITL + safety disengagement

then.rationale_template: Autonomous action is enabled; define human decision gates and safe disengagement/incident response controls.
Regulated/sensitive data is used; apply minimisation, access controls, privacy mitigations, output disclosure protections, and secure integrations.

recommendation_rules.name: Fairness risks present => bias testing + affected group review

then.rationale_template: Fairness inherent risk is {domain_inherent_risk_level}; test/monitor for bias and review impacts on affected groups.

recommendation_rules.name: Workforce impacts indicated => workforce impact controls

then.rationale_template: Workforce impacts are {B1.3}; manage workforce change and monitor broader wellbeing impacts.

recommendation_rules.name: High inherent but low residual => sustain controls (future enhancements)

then.rationale_template: Controls are currently effective in {domain} (low residual) despite high inherent exposure; maintain assurance to prevent regression.
